title: Trader Diary: BTC at $80,455 🚀
content:
- 8 AM: “Just a quick 2x long, I’ll exit at $81k.”
- 12 PM: “Why is it still below $81k? Must be the market’s conspiracy.”
- 3 PM: “Leverage maxed, now I’m a human candle on the chart.”
lesson: Set a stop‑loss before the coffee gets cold – leverage loves your sleep schedule.
question: Who else turned a “quick trade” into a full‑day marathon? Spill the beans 👇
